executeplayer: Hold to execute downed player (requires a weapon)
stowplayer: Hold to stow dragged player on the back
succumb: You will succumb to your wounds in about {0}.
passout: You will pass out in about {0}.
no-commands: You cannot run this command while downed.
DurationSeconds-comment: Seconds a player can stay downed before succumbing to their wounds.
DownedCooldownIngameHours-comment: A player downed again within this many in-game hours of their last downing dies immediately instead. 0 = no cooldown.
DownedFloorHealth-comment: Health fraction (0-1) a player is left with while downed.
CrawlWalkSpeedMultiplier-comment: Walk speed change while crawling. Negative values slow the player down.
HideMap-comment: Hide the world map and coordinates while downed.
MonstersIgnoreDowned-comment: Hostile creatures stop targeting a player while they are downed.
AllowSelfRevive-comment: Downed players can revive themselves by applying a healing item to themselves.
PassedOutEnabled-comment: Bleeding out no longer kills you right away. Instead you pass out for a while.
PassedOutChoiceSeconds-comment: Seconds the player has to say how they went down. Running out counts as the world killing them.
PassedOutDecisionTimeoutSeconds-comment: Seconds to wait for another mod to decide whether the player dies.
PassedOutFallbackDie-comment: Kill the player when no mod hooks into the death event and replies in time. Off means they survive and pass out.
PassedOutPvpDie-comment: Kill the player when another player put them down and no mod hooks into the death event. Off means they pass out.
PassedOutRecoverySeconds-comment: Seconds a player stays passed out before coming round on their own.
PassedOutInvulnerabilitySeconds-comment: Seconds a player takes no damage after waking up from being passed out (0 = no protection).
PassedOutMoveToShore-comment: A player who passes out in water or lava gets moved to the nearest dry spot (up to 256 blocks away).
PassedOutHealth-comment: Fraction of max health (0-1) a player heals back up to while passed out.
PassedOutHealIntervalSeconds-comment: Seconds between each health tick while passed out.
PassedOutMuteAudio-comment: Silence game sound and proximity voice chat for a passed out player, and stop others hearing them.
PassedOutMuteChat-comment: A passed out player cannot send or read chat.
PassedOutText-comment: Text shown on the passed out screen. Supports VTML formatting. {{0}} is replaced with the time left.
deathchoice-subtitle: What put you down, another player (PvP) or the environment (PvE)?
GiveUpHoldSeconds-comment: Seconds the give-up hotkey must be held to give up.
GiveUpText-comment: Text shown under the downed timer. Supports VTML formatting. The default uses a hotkey tag to show whatever key give up is bound to.
ExecuteHoldSeconds-comment: Seconds the execute interaction must be held to finish a downed player.
ExecuteRange-comment: Maximum distance in blocks to start an execute.
ExecuteInterruptDamage-comment: Total damage the executioner can take before the execute is interrupted.
DragHoldSeconds-comment: Seconds the drag interaction must be held to start dragging.
DragWalkSpeedMultiplier-comment: Walk speed change for the dragger. Negative values slow them down.
DragRange-comment: Maximum distance in blocks to start a drag.
DragMaxDistance-comment: Distance in blocks before an in-progress drag is broken.
stowblocked: A stowed player is in the way
StowHoldSeconds-comment: Seconds the stow interaction must be held to stow a dragged player onto an animal's back.
StowRange-comment: Maximum distance in blocks to stow a dragged player onto an animal.
BloodTrailParticles-comment: Spawn blood particles along a dragged player's path.
BloodTrailDecals-comment: Leave blood decals on the ground along a dragged player's path.
BloodTrailDistance-comment: Distance in blocks between blood trail marks.
BloodTrailSpread-comment: Random spread in blocks applied to blood trail marks.
BloodTrailParticleSeconds-comment: Seconds each blood particle lives before fading.
ExecuteBloodExplosion-comment: Spray blood particles and paint blood decals on nearby surfaces when an execution finishes.
ExecuteBloodRange-comment: Sphere radius in blocks within which surfaces get painted with blood on execution.
ExecuteBloodRayCount-comment: Number of rays cast outward to find surfaces to paint. Higher means denser, more performance cost.
ExecuteBloodParticleCount-comment: Number of blood particles sprayed when an execution finishes.
BloodDecalCleanupIngameDays-comment: Remove blood decals once this many in-game days have passed since they were placed. Cleanup happens as chunks load. Set to 0 to keep blood forever.
LongLastingBloodDecalChance-comment: Chance (0-1) that a blood decal lasts twice as long before the aged cleanup removes it. 0.1 = 10%.
MaxBloodDecalsPerFace: Max blood decals per block face
MaxBloodDecalsPerFace-comment: Maximum number of blood decals on a single face of a block. Once a face is full, new splatter refreshes the cleanup timer of the existing decals instead of adding more. 0 = unlimited.
BloodDecalCleanupIntervalMinutes-comment: Real-time minutes between automatic blood decal cleanup passes over loaded chunks.
BloodDecalRainWashHours-comment: In-game hours of rain it takes to wash away fresh blood that is open to the sky. Long-lasting decals take twice as long, snow does not count. Blood disappears on the next cleanup pass, not while it rains. Set to 0 to disable.
execute-no-pvp: Cannot execute other players, PvP is not enabled
execute-no-privilege: You are not allowed to attack other players
